ktzh_desc: I developed a mobile-only internal web application for KTZH employees using React, leading the development independently while the mentor supervised. The app was exclusively optimized for mobile devices and featured a search functionality that allowed employees to quickly find and navigate to the sections they needed.

The site serves as a complete online presence for the company — visitors can explore information about ITM's services and submit requests through a built-in application form. I handled the entire development from scratch while the mentor provided feedback when necessary.
